name: Wasting Love Cln

band.style_feel: slow, brooding rock ballad: sparse half-time drums building to a full, driving band in the choruses
parts: Part A: intro/verse - clean arpeggio, quiet sparse drums
Part B: chorus - full band, power chords
Part C: guitar solo - lead section
band.tips: BPM (85) and key (E minor, from a fan tab) are unverified web-search estimates; check by ear. Play the intro riff cleanly for 2 bars before the Trio+ starts learning; keep strumming steady.

whammy.tuning: Standard (E A D G B E) - unverified
how: Tune your guitar to standard (E A D G B E) and check by ear against the recording.
If the recording sounds a half step lower (Eb), turn the right knob to TRANSPOSE DOWN 1 and press DROPTUNE.
whammy.tips: Could not verify the tuning or any whammy/octave/harmony effect on the recording by web search; the one tab found lists the riff in E minor without a tuning. Treat standard tuning as a best guess and verify by ear.

memo: Iron Maiden - Wasting Love: clean arpeggio intro/verses. Strat-style sparkle, chorus and a touch of delay, lots of reverb. Informed approximation.

name: Wasting Love Crn
